description: Explains one Human Design element in plain words: a type ("Projector"), an authority ("emotional authority"), a profile ("4/6"), a line ("line 3"), a definition ("split definition"), a centre ("Sacral"), a channel ("34-20"), a gate ("gate 51") or a basic topic ("what is Human Design", "open centres"). Gives the title and summary, the full text for types, authorities, profiles, definitions and basics, and the related centres, channels and gates.

language.description: Language of the titles and summaries: en (default), nl (Dutch) or de (German).

topic.description: The element or topic, e.g. "Manifesting Generator", "splenic authority", "2/4", "gate 34", "channel 10-20", "Ajna centre".

name: explain
title: Explain a Human Design term
